what: terminal export of an append-only transparency log
proves: that these leaf bytes, in this order, produce the final root
that the log key signed that root at this size
that the listed witnesses cosigned the same root
that any receipt naming an index <= final_tree_size can be rechecked against this frozen tree
does_not_prove: that the recorded claims are true
that the log was complete (nothing withheld)
that the log key belonged to any particular operator - key-to-identity binding is a social fact this bundle freezes but cannot establish
